title: agentdag handover record (design 3.8)
description: Written by a node that hit its context ceiling; read by its successor as part of the brief. Typed fields only - the coordinator branches on none of the prose.

node_id.description: The node this record belongs to; stamped by the coordinator, not the node.

attempt.description: Which attempt produced this record; matches the node spec's attempt, like result-record.schema.json. The coordinator stamps it (design 3.8, decision 16): the duty never asks the node for it and the node cannot know it.

continuation.description: 0 for the first node of a chain; the successor is dispatched with continuation + 1 in its journal key. Stamped by the coordinator, not the node.

done.description: Short items, one per completed sub-step.

left.description: Short items, one per remaining sub-step, in order.

key_facts.description: The brief's typed output-schema keys that are already known.

artefact_refs.description: Paths under the node's artefact dir the successor should read first.

write_set_state.description: Whether the worktree holds uncommitted work the successor must continue from.

next_step.description: The single next action, one sentence.

done: ran make test once: red on test_mail.py
left: fix the two failing mail tests
examples.next_step: open tests/test_mail.py and inject the Transport double at the seam
